final_message: I parsed the log file by reading each entry and filtering only those with level ERROR or CRITICAL (case insensitive). For each such entry, I converted the timestamp to UTC in the required format, extracted the service, level (uppercased), and message (text after the service name and colon on the first line). If the entry had a traceback, I took the last line as the exception; otherwise, I set it to null. I also summed the repeat counts from any following "-- last message repeated N times --" lines. Finally, I aggregated the total repeat counts by service. The results were saved in workspace/errors.json following the Acme log-triage conventions.
